items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: Black Benny had one of those same traps himself. Black Benny the drummer, you might have heard of him. Yeah, we've all heard of him.

ctx.x: It would pull it in. You'd raise your foot up and the spring pulls it back out.

That's right. It was something very fast. It was very fast. Fast, huh? Oh, yeah. It was fast. It was faster than beater they got. Now, that thing was very fast. Really? I never thought. Oh, yeah. You had to have a good steady foot to control it, because that thing would pull you out of time. You'd have to know what you're doing to fool the overhead trap. It really was tricky. Yeah, it was very fast. I never could buy any more. I went around around these pawnshouts and tried to, you know, like by Big Jake or Fings…
